value.rationale: This natural sparse DNA-spectrum observation problem has a sharp minimal permanent stabilization length n=3k, an explicit quadratic-in-k zero-error capacity, and a complete partition of all C(n,3) original indexed sources into exact inverse-fiber sizes. The label structure reveals when clockwise orientation is observationally invisible and supplies quantitative ambiguity beyond a mere injectivity threshold. It is an exact infinite family of motivated reconstruction invariants, not an arbitrary finite slice or a computational-only table.
